name: augelab
description: Build computer vision and AI workflows in AugeLab Studio through its local MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: Build and inspect computer vision and AI workflows, from image processing and visual inspection to model training. Setup on Windows x64 and Linux x86-64/ARM64 downloads and installs Studio when missing, then guides account registration, license activation, and local MCP connection. Requires a valid Studio license. macOS is not supported.
defaultPrompt: Use AugeLab to build a visual inspection project from my sample images.
